character.name: Fiammetta
character.itemUsage: Fiammetta, senior special correspondent of the Laterano Notarial Hall, will persevere to the end once a goal has been set.
character.itemDesc: Don't ask her about her codename, lest she make the time to take you out.

levels.name: 'Reponite'

Continuously barrages a fixed area in front of this unit at max range, <@ba.vup>expanding</> explosion area and increasing ATK to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_2:0%}</>. Enemies closer to the impact site in a smaller area will instead take <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as damage. 
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration, can manually deactivate skill</>

runtimeMapping.ordinaryAttack: Original Front/Back Attack event .833/min(1,ASPD/100); retain valid input or replace at release. Homing speed8 lifetime10 radius1 physical burst maps to shared XY projectile movement. S1 uses its separately authored projectile with the same fields.
runtimeMapping.S1: Selected additive ATK percentage and forward range extension for the selected duration. Offensive SP gains on ordinary attack release, stays blocked during skill. Matches the pinned Global prefab; later CN-only selection/range changes are not silently imported.
runtimeMapping.S2: Native fixed-tile selector filter12 maps to farthest actual tile on the original facing-axis grid. Begin .233, Loop hit .833 and End .567 map the empty native animKey FSM to original skeleton clips at uncapped ASPD. Parent speed8 radius1.5 uses selected atk_scale; each selected .66 distance mark produces an independent .8-delay radius1.1 burst with selected atk_scale_2. All fired shells use current source ATK even after retirement.
runtimeMapping.S3: Explicit tile-target profile allows bombardment without enemies. Initial .2 Begin clip; Loop .033/min(1,ASPD/100) event emits a fixed .5-delay shell. Native radius2 victims each receive one selected centre-scale hit at distance <=1.1, otherwise outer scale. Shared cadence respects projectile-plus-.567 escape. Toggle ends on manual stop. Original facing-axis centre excludes all range extension.
runtimeMapping.Regeneration: Native .1 interval maps to scheduled callbacks on the first engine phase at/after each deadline. Pure direct nonlethal ceiling loss of selected fraction of current HP bypasses incoming mitigation and grants no SP. Deployment owns the clock; retirement cancels it.
runtimeMapping.Vigor: Selected promotion/potential peak thresholds are strict >; high tier doubles the selected first tier. One named Vigor contribution uses shared highest-value priority. Rechecked after each drain pulse, removed on retirement.
runtimeMapping.Herald: Selected additive ASPD outside active skills; native stop-buff override maps to removing it during every skill and restoring it on end. Original Begin/Loop/End and mode2 clips are used for each delivered facing.

verificationLimits: Original compiled filter12 tile routing and empty-animKey FSM dispatcher are not recovered executable C#. Axis endpoint, Begin/Loop/End sequencing, release cancellation and same-frame callbacks are reviewed local mappings; frameParity remains false.

HP loss and Vigor use shared scheduler phases. Periodic Vigor versus damage callback priority, external MAX HP/shield interactions, lethal-victim follow-up and equal-priority foreign buffs are not native-frame certified.

S2 uses fixed-distance XY marks and independent delayed child bursts. Animated MUZZLE transforms, parabolic height, projectile reuse and native continuous-collider sweep ordering are not reproduced. Timer/projectile emission is quantized to the shared 1/30-second engine.

S3 native stationary .5-delay projectile maps to a shared fixed-destination XY flight. Tile targets deliberately opt in to AI validation and cannot become blocking enemies. Original native particles, blast graphics, audio and modules remain unsupported.
The pinned Global source predates the later CN S1 air-target/range quirks described by updated community notes. No CN skill-table refresh is implied.

sourceReferences.notes: Authored mechanics checked against native prefab/buff fields for drain, Vigor thresholds, S2 distance trail/delay and S3 empty-tile bombardment. Newer CN-only S1 notes are outside the pinned Global behavior.
